Title: Sign in with valid username
Steps: Enter valid username; submit; complete Microsoft authentication
Expected Result: Tenant is identified and Microsoft login is opened.

Title: Unknown username
Expected Result: User is not authenticated and a clear failure/retry path is shown.

Title: Username is empty
Expected Result: Submission is blocked and username validation is shown.

Title: Username with leading/trailing spaces
Expected Result: Input is normalized or rejected consistently; no incorrect tenant lookup.

Title: /user/who tenant lookup succeeds
Expected Result: /user/who is called and tenant context is resolved.

Title: /user/me is requested after authentication
Expected Result: /user/me is requested and user profile is loaded.

Title: /tenant/master is requested
Expected Result: /tenant/master is requested and master-data bootstrap starts.

Title: Master data endpoints show progress
Expected Result: Progress is visible while required master data is loaded.

Title: First master-data update prompts restart
Expected Result: App prompts user to restart as specified.

Title: Slow network during bootstrap
Expected Result: Progress remains accurate; UI does not appear frozen; eventually recovers.

Title: Backend bootstrap failure
Expected Result: Failure is handled safely and user has actionable retry/error state.

Title: Unauthenticated user cannot access protected app
Expected Result: User is redirected to authentication.

Title: Open Equipment Inspection list
Expected Result: Previous submissions are displayed and new submission action is available.

Title: Create inspection from Form Code
Preconditions: At least one form configuration exists
Steps: Start new inspection; select Form Code
Expected Result: Correct dynamic fields are rendered for selected Form Code.

Title: Text field renders and accepts input
Expected Result: Value is accepted and retained.

Title: Date picker renders valid date
Expected Result: Selected date is displayed and stored in expected format.

Title: Select field options load
Expected Result: Configured options are shown and selection is retained.

Title: Radio supports up to four options
Expected Result: Configured options are available and only one option can be selected.

Title: Image picker accepts supported image
Expected Result: Image is attached and preview/state is shown.

Title: Form supports 50 fields
Expected Result: All 50 configured fields render and remain usable.

Title: Form with more than 50 fields is rejected or constrained
Expected Result: System enforces documented maximum of 50.

Title: Required dynamic field cannot be empty
Expected Result: Submission is blocked with validation.

Title: Valid inspection can be submitted
Expected Result: Submission succeeds and appears in previous submissions.

Title: Submitted values persist after refresh
Expected Result: Saved values match submitted values.

Title: Inspection submission under poor network
Expected Result: User gets clear progress/retry behavior; duplicate record is not created.

Title: Create/edit behavior with no network
Steps: Open feature; attempt supported offline actions
Expected Result: App follows offline capability without losing entered data.

Title: Previously configured form remains readable after configuration change
Steps: Change form configuration; open old submission
Expected Result: Historical submission remains readable and data is not corrupted.

Title: Open Hazard list
Expected Result: Hazard list is displayed and report action is available.

Title: Location is mandatory
Expected Result: Submission is blocked.

Title: Sublocation is mandatory
Expected Result: Submission is blocked.

Title: Area is mandatory
Expected Result: Submission is blocked.

Title: Area Description is optional
Steps: Leave description empty; fill other mandatory fields
Expected Result: Submission can proceed without Area Description.

Title: Evidence is mandatory
Expected Result: Submission is blocked.

Title: PIC is mandatory and preselected to reporter
Expected Result: PIC defaults to current reporter and can be changed only as permitted.

Title: Valid hazard can be submitted
Expected Result: Hazard entry is created and follow-up task is generated.

Title: PIC receives follow-up notification
Expected Result: PIC receives notification for follow-up task.

Title: People in area receive hazard notification
Expected Result: People in the area receive hazard notification.

Title: Follow-up task opens for PIC
Expected Result: Task contains required follow-up fields.

Title: Resolution Date is mandatory
Expected Result: Submission is blocked.

Title: Follow-up evidence can be added
Expected Result: Evidence is accepted and retained.

Title: Co Observer can add multiple fields
Expected Result: Additional Co Observer selectors are added without losing existing selections.

Title: Co Observer selections remain unique if duplicates are disallowed
Steps: Select same observer in multiple fields
Expected Result: System prevents duplicates if uniqueness is required by business rules.

Title: Valid follow-up can be submitted
Steps: Fix issue; add Resolution Date; submit
Expected Result: Follow-up is completed and direct supervisor notification is triggered.

Title: Direct Supervisor receives completion notification
Expected Result: Direct Supervisor receives notification for the completed follow-up.

Title: Duplicate hazard is not created on retry
Expected Result: At most one hazard entry is created for one logical submission.

Title: Hazard behavior with no network
Steps: Create/report hazard according to supported offline flow
Expected Result: User data is retained and sync behavior follows product rules.
